info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get External Agency By Param1-spec
info.description: This API enables users to retrieve detailed information about external agencies based on a unique identifier (param1). It supports use cases such as querying agency data for financial verification, regulatory compliance, and partnership evaluation. Typical consumers include banking and finance institutions, compliance officers, and integration systems requiring access to vetted agency information. Utilizing this API streamlines the process of agency identification and enhances operational efficiencies.

get.description: Fetches the detailed information of the syndicate management for the specified resource ID. This endpoint provides essential data needed for understanding the status and attributes of the syndicate management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to syndicate management for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the request adheres to the specified schema for successful processing.

200.description: Successful retrieval of syndicate management details.
